title: A happy guy …
excerpt: On Monday, Ella McLaren Stone entered the world – our second grandchild, joining Averie her cousin, who will be one year old tomorrow. She’s sleeping right beside me now. Awesome. Beautiful. Miraculous. As you can imagine, I’m one happy granddad.
body:
On Monday, Ella McLaren Stone entered the world – our second grandchild, joining Averie her cousin, who will be one year old tomorrow. She’s sleeping right beside me now. Awesome. Beautiful. Miraculous.

As you can imagine, I’m one happy granddad.
